- What the tweet commits to: one strategy combining **RSI** (short-horizon oversold/momentum), **ADX** (trend-strength filter), and **IBS** — Internal Bar Strength, `(Close−Low)/(High−Low)`, i.e. where the close sits inside the bar's range.

## Why it matters
- The stack maps to the classic three questions of a conditioned mean-reversion entry: RSI = is it oversold? ADX = is trend strength absent (or present)? IBS = did the bar close near its low? (Indicator roles are domain background, not the article's exact rules — those are behind the wall.)
- Second RSI-based capture of the 2026-08-29/30 systematic-trading cluster: pairs directly with the Milk Man RSI(2) dip-buy — same short-horizon oversold core, but conditioned on ADX/IBS instead of a 200-SMA trend filter.
